title: Run interface
description: The entry point and result of one execution of the loop (C1), opened inside a session (C5) and surfaced by the interface (C6).

goal.description: One user request, normalized to text (C7).

status.description: complete: finished with an answer. incomplete: the run stalled or hit the step ceiling, best-effort answer. blocked: guard denied or unrecoverable error (may have no answer).

reason.description: Why the run blocked or ended incomplete; optional otherwise.
